observation: Stub-the-seam-where-the-bug-lives anti-pattern: 3 review rounds (H1, H2, H3). Round 1 happy-path test used ScriptedAdapter that hardcoded reply regardless of input → happy suite green while resolveAgentModel never called (H1), notice field stripped from schema read-back (H2), user message never reached model (H3 only discovered in round 2). All three invisible to green suite. Cost: 6 days across 3 review/fix cycles.

Round 2 closure of H1 (model resolution added, types correct) unmasked H3 as a deeper defect. The turn no longer threw but still failed — transcript builder loaded the thread correctly but buildSessionConfig never captured triggerMessageId; builtin adapter ran planning-loop not chat-turn. Plan §1.4 explicitly mandated 'conversational context (no task)' but builder implemented it without reading the spec.

triggerMessageId declared on AssistantTurnParams:85 but never read until round 3 fix. Field survived type-checking and two review rounds because the loadThreadTranscript workaround (loading the whole thread) made it redundant at runtime. Declared-but-unread is a weaker signal than unused, but caught by H3 adversarial test that required message capture.

as unknown as Parameters<...>[0] cast in assistant-turn.ts:340 (round 1) escaped type checking for SessionConfig mismatch (missing resolvedModel, extra messages field). Cast allowed misshapen config to compile and masquerade as correct until H1 review. No test discriminated valid SessionConfig shape.

Adversarial reviewer lens caught H1 + H3 + H2 across 2 rounds that green suite missed. Strict producer/evaluator separation (builder vs 3-round reviewer) paid off. Critique loop folded 4 WARNINGs (W1 durability, W2 persona equality, design W1 Retry state, W2 mono font) into plan before red phase.

H3 fix validated by two discriminating tests: capturing adapter echoes user message (fails if messages empty), validating adapter emits error if exact question missing (fails if transcript not delivered). Both tests would have failed silently under the prior ScriptedAdapter regime. Demonstrates that test discriminating power is the inverse of stub-the-seam brittleness.

Design contract violation D4: plan §5 + design/approved.md mandated 'migrate both textareas to design-system Input' but implementation kept raw <textarea className=textarea-bordered> in SettingsAssistant (with font-mono, contradicting design W2). Inline style={borderRadius:...} override masked the spec non-compliance. Design system reuse intent unmet.

BUILTIN_SOUL_PROMPT literal duplicated ×3 (assistant-turn.ts, users.ts, assistant.ts) across registration, lazy-create, and turn-start paths. All byte-identical currently; risk is silent drift. Minors accepted as cosmetic for round-3 cap but indicates missed consolidation opportunity.
